{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicates)}")
print(f"List of duplicate patient IDs: {duplicates.index.tolist()}\n")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999
print(f"Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline.sum()}")
print(f"Percentage of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline.mean() * 100:.1f}%\n")

# Check assay_batch values
print("Assay batch distribution:")
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
